notes: Source of truth for generated art. tools/make-briefs.mjs turns each entry into art/prompts/<id>.md; tools/codex-gen.mjs runs codex exec for it; tools/postprocess.py writes the runtime file.

assets.pose: Standing relaxed, weight on one leg, hands loose: left hand in jacket pocket, right (gloved) hand at her side. Calm, attentive, closed-mouth neutral expression.
Standing tall and relaxed, one hand in trouser pocket, the other holding the end of his scarf. Gentle half-smile, calm neutral expression.
Standing perfectly upright, gloved hands clasped in front at waist height. Composed, unreadable neutral expression.
Standing square and sturdy, thumbs hooked in the tool belt. Mild, friendly neutral expression.
Standing with feet apart, fluffy microphone held up in the right hand at shoulder height, left hand holding the recorder strap. Curious open neutral expression.
Standing straight, folio tucked under the left arm, right hand straightening his tie. Polite, cool neutral expression.
Standing slightly hunched, clipboard held against the chest with both hands. Quiet, tired neutral expression.

assets.change: Right (gloved) hand raised to her chin, eyes looking slightly down and to the side, brows knit in concentration.
Eyes wide, mouth slightly open, shoulders raised, right hand half-raised in front of the chest.

Warm broad grin with deep smile lines, eyes crinkled, the free hand raised in a casual wave.

Eyes widened behind the glasses, lips parted, one gloved hand raised to her collar.
Eyes lowered and glistening, brows raised in grief, one gloved hand gripping the opposite forearm.
Big hearty laugh, eyes squeezed into laugh lines, one hand on his belly.
Bushy eyebrows shot up, mouth open in an O, both hands raised palms out.
Brows knitted with guilt and worry, eyes looking down, one hand rubbing the back of his neck (beanie stays on).
Excited gap-tooth grin, sparkling eyes, the free left hand raised in a small fist pump.
Startled, eyes huge, mouth wide open, microphone pulled in to her chest, shoulders up.
Teary eyes, trembling lip, hugging the fluffy microphone to her chest with both arms.
Self-satisfied smirk, chin raised, right hand adjusting a gold cufflink.

Looking down at the clipboard, a pen tapped against the lips, worried concentration.
Flinching back, eyes wide, clipboard clutched tight to the chest.
Breaking down: tears on the cheeks, one hand pressing the headset against the head, shoulders collapsed forward.

assets.scene: Kestrel Tower at night in a violent storm on a mountain ridge: a tall steel lattice radio mast with a single coral-red beacon, a squat brutalist concrete building at its base with one warm acid-yellow window, a thin cable-car line vanishing down into rain and cloud. A huge stylized tuning-dial ring and concentric radio waves printed across the sky like a screen-print. Graphic-novel poster, bold ink linework, flat colors, halftone rain. Keep the upper-left third calm dark sky (space for a title added later in code).

Inside a small radio broadcast booth at night, seen through the control-room glass: an empty swivel chair turned slightly away, a microphone on a boom arm, a pair of headphones hanging, a large reel-to-reel tape machine beside the desk with reels spinning, a blank glowing coral-red lamp box above the door (no letters on it). Eerie emptiness, cyan monitor glow, dramatic graphic-novel panel.

Wide graphic-novel panel inside a steel tape vault: tall shelves of reel-to-reel tape boxes, a thin white haze of CO2 fog pooled near the floor, cold deep-cyan emergency light and one coral warning lamp. The man from the reference image (same amber glasses, yellow turtleneck, coral scarf, black leather jacket, salt-and-pepper hair) sits slumped against a shelf, head bowed, face mostly hidden by hair and glasses, large closed-back headphones still on his head, a portable reel deck beside him, loose tape unspooled on the floor. Somber and quiet. Absolutely no blood, no wounds, nothing gory.

Extreme close-up graphic-novel panel in a dark gas room: a hand in an oversized charcoal hoodie sleeve with a frayed cuff and a single deep-cyan stripe grips a red manual release lever on a wall-mounted station whose cover is painted fresh acid yellow. A steel safety pin on a small tag has been pulled out and hangs on its chain. The wet yellow paint is smeared. A small blue-cyan LED glow reflects on the paint from off-frame. No face visible. Tense, dramatic lighting.

Warm memory panel: the man from the reference image (same amber glasses, yellow turtleneck, coral scarf, black leather jacket, salt-and-pepper hair) sits alone in a small radio booth under a single warm lamp, leaning close to a microphone, eyes closed, a sad gentle smile, recording a message. Soft violet night outside the booth window. Graphic-novel ink and flat color with gentle halftone.

Epilogue panel: the same storm-worn mountain radio tower at dawn, clouds breaking, warm paper-white sunlight spilling over the ridge, puddles reflecting the sky, a small red cable-car cabin arriving at the station. Six tiny silhouettes stand at the building entrance looking at the sunrise. Hopeful, quiet, graphic-novel poster style.

A large painted wall mural on concrete: a stylized kestrel falcon with spread wings whose feathers are made of concentric radio waves, hovering above a lattice radio tower and mountain ridge. Retro 1970s public-works mural style, limited flat colors, visible brush texture and slight weathering. No text, no letters.

Screen-printed radio-show poster artwork (no text at all): the man from the reference image shown waist-up in bold two-tone silhouette with his amber glasses catching light, speaking into a vintage ribbon microphone, a huge crescent moon and concentric radio waves behind him, violet night sky. Leave the bottom quarter as plain flat color (a title is added later in code).

A faded vintage 1979 group photograph: eight station staff in late-1970s clothes and headsets standing in front of banks of reel-to-reel recorders and blinking switchboards, serious expressions, one man in a dark suit in the middle. Duotone cyan-and-paper tones, film grain, slight scratches, white photo border. No text.

View out of a tall window at night: a deep mountain valley in heavy slanting rain, dark ridges, a few warm lights of a distant valley town far below, a fork of lightning behind clouds. Painterly graphic-novel background, limited violet, ink and cyan palette.

Change ONLY the time of day and weather: the storm has cleared into early dawn, warm paper-white and pale acid-yellow light rising behind the ridges, thin clouds, no rain, no lightning. Keep the exact same composition, valley, ridges and town.
